package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("label", flag.ExitOnError)
	kg := fs.Int("kg", 1, "weight in kilograms")
	fragile := fs.Bool("fragile", false, "handle with care")
	fs.Parse(os.Args[1:])
	fmt.Println("kg:", *kg)
	fmt.Println("fragile:", *fragile)
	fmt.Println("stops:", fs.Args())
	fmt.Println("count:", fs.NArg())
}

signal_self.go.src:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
)

func main() {
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
	defer stop()
	fmt.Println("dock open: press Ctrl+C to close")

	// Pretend someone pressed Ctrl+C: the program sends itself that signal.
	syscall.Kill(os.Getpid(), syscall.SIGINT)

	<-ctx.Done()
	fmt.Println("closing up:", context.Cause(ctx))
	fmt.Println("gate locked")
}
